sources: https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo} and /readme for each listed server; tool names checked in source files where noted

servers.name: Fetch
servers.summary_zh: 抓取任意網址並轉成 Markdown 供模型閱讀
servers.summary_en: Fetches any URL and converts it to Markdown for the model to read.
servers.risk_zh: 被注入的指令可讓它讀取內網或本機位址（README 明列此風險），把敏感頁面內容帶回對話
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could make it read internal-network or localhost addresses (a risk the README explicitly notes) and carry sensitive page content back into the conversation.
servers.evidence: src/fetch/README.md: single tool `fetch`; CAUTION note says it can access local/internal IP addresses. No read-only/allowlist option (only --ignore-robots-txt, user-agent, proxy). Stars are shared by the whole modelcontextprotocol/servers monorepo. License: repo LICENSE describes an MIT-to-Apache-2.0 transition (GitHub reports NOASSERTION), so license set null.

servers.name: Context7
servers.auth: API key (optional; OAuth via ctx7 setup)
servers.summary_zh: 查詢各程式庫最新版官方文件與範例
servers.summary_en: Looks up the latest official documentation and examples for various libraries.
servers.risk_zh: 唯讀查詢；風險在於回傳的第三方文件內容可能夾帶提示注入，誤導代理後續動作
servers.risk_en: Read-only lookups; the risk is that returned third-party documentation may carry prompt injection that misleads the agent's later actions.
servers.evidence: README 'Available Tools > MCP Tools': `resolve-library-id`, `query-docs` only (both read). Remote https://mcp.context7.com/mcp plus npm @upstash/context7-mcp (registry entry io.github.upstash/context7). No read-only mode needed/documented.

servers.name: Apify
servers.summary_zh: 呼叫 Apify 爬蟲 Actor 擷取社群、搜尋與網站資料
servers.summary_en: Calls Apify scraper Actors to extract social, search, and website data.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可呼叫付費 Actor 消耗額度、建立排程定期執行，或公開發佈任務頁面
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could call paid Actors to burn through credits, set up schedules that run on a recurring basis, or publicly publish task pages.
servers.evidence: README tools table lists call-actor (default), abort-actor-run, create-schedule/delete-schedule, publish-actor-task, build-actor. `tools=` URL param / `--tools` CLI flag selects categories or individual tools (allowlist). Remote https://mcp.apify.com.

servers.name: Firecrawl
servers.auth: API key or OAuth (keyless tier limited)
servers.summary_zh: 網頁搜尋、爬取與擷取，轉成乾淨 Markdown
servers.summary_en: Web search, crawling, and extraction, turned into clean Markdown.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可用雲端瀏覽器點擊、輸入表單（interact），或大量爬站、建立監控消耗額度
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could use the cloud browser to click and fill forms (interact), or mass-crawl sites and create monitors that consume credits.
servers.evidence: README: 26 tools incl. firecrawl_interact (click/type/navigate), firecrawl_monitor_create/delete, firecrawl_crawl. Restricted surfaces documented: keyless endpoint exposes only scrape/search/parse; search-only endpoint /v2/mcp-search exposes a fixed 8-tool set; hosted scrape takes no browser actions.

servers.name: Exa
servers.summary_zh: Exa 網路搜尋、網頁讀取與研究代理
servers.summary_en: Exa web search, page reading, and research agent.
servers.risk_zh: 以查詢為主；回傳的網頁內容可能含提示注入，且 API key 可能放在網址參數中外洩
servers.risk_en: Primarily read-only; returned web content may contain prompt injection, and the API key can leak when placed in a URL parameter.
servers.evidence: README tools table: web_search_exa, web_fetch_exa, web_search_advanced_exa, agent_run (all read/research). `?tools=` URL parameter selects tools (allowlist). README documents API key via `?exaApiKey=` URL param or header. Hosted at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp; npm package also published.

servers.name: Perplexity
servers.summary_zh: Perplexity 即時搜尋、推理與深度研究
servers.summary_en: Perplexity real-time search, reasoning, and deep research.
servers.risk_zh: 唯讀查詢；搜尋結果中的網頁內容可能夾帶提示注入，並會消耗付費 API 額度
servers.risk_en: Read-only lookups; web content in search results may carry prompt injection, and calls consume paid API credits.
servers.evidence: README tools: perplexity_search, perplexity_ask, perplexity_research, perplexity_reason (all read-only). Remote https://api.perplexity.ai/mcp or npx @perplexity-ai/mcp-server. No tool-restriction option documented.

servers.name: Tavily
servers.summary_zh: Tavily 網路搜尋、擷取、網站地圖與爬取
servers.summary_en: Tavily web search, extraction, site mapping, and crawling.
servers.risk_zh: 唯讀查詢；遠端模式把 API key 放在網址參數，爬取內容也可能夾帶提示注入
servers.risk_en: Read-only lookups; the remote mode puts the API key in a URL parameter, and crawled content may also carry prompt injection.
servers.evidence: src/index.ts registers tavily_search, tavily_extract, tavily_crawl, tavily_map, tavily_research, tavily_feedback (no writes to user data). README: remote https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp/?tavilyApiKey=... ; DEFAULT_PARAMETERS header sets defaults, not a tool restriction.

servers.name: Google Maps (cablate)
servers.summary_zh: Google 地圖地點搜尋、路線、天氣與空氣品質
servers.summary_en: Google Maps place search, directions, weather, and air quality.
servers.risk_zh: 唯讀查詢；主要風險是位置與行程查詢外洩，以及濫用你的 Google Maps API 額度
servers.risk_en: Read-only lookups; the main risks are leaking location and itinerary queries and burning through your Google Maps API quota.
servers.evidence: README tool list: maps_search_places, maps_directions, maps_weather, maps_air_quality, maps_geocode, maps_plan_route etc. (all lookups). Runs locally (stdio or --port HTTP) with GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY. No tool restriction documented. Official MCP reference Google Maps server is archived (servers-archived), Google's mapstools remote has no public repo.

servers.name: Filesystem
servers.summary_zh: 在指定資料夾內讀寫、搜尋、搬移檔案
servers.summary_en: Read, write, search, and move files within designated folders.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可覆寫或搬移允許目錄內的檔案，或讀出其中的金鑰、文件並轉交其他工具外傳
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could overwrite or move files inside the allowed directories, or read out keys and documents there and hand them to other tools for exfiltration.
servers.evidence: src/filesystem/README.md tool list + annotation table (write_file/edit_file/move_file destructiveHint). Access limited to allowed directories / MCP Roots; Docker example mounts directories with `ro` to make them read-only. Stars are shared by the whole modelcontextprotocol/servers monorepo. License: repo LICENSE describes an MIT-to-Apache-2.0 transition (GitHub reports NOASSERTION), so license set null.

servers.name: Git
servers.summary_zh: 讀取與操作本機 Git 儲存庫（差異、提交、分支）
servers.summary_en: Read and operate on a local Git repository (diffs, commits, branches).
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可提交、重設或切換分支，竄改或丟棄本機未提交的工作
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could commit, reset, or switch branches, tampering with or discarding uncommitted local work.
servers.evidence: src/git/README.md tools 1-12: git_commit, git_add, git_reset, git_checkout, git_create_branch are write ops. --repository scopes to one repo; no read-only mode documented. Stars are shared by the whole modelcontextprotocol/servers monorepo. License: repo LICENSE describes an MIT-to-Apache-2.0 transition (GitHub reports NOASSERTION), so license set null.

servers.name: GitHub MCP Server
servers.summary_zh: 讀寫 GitHub 程式庫、Issue、PR 與 Actions
servers.summary_en: Read and write GitHub repositories, issues, PRs, and Actions.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令（例如藏在 Issue 內）可讓它推送程式碼、合併 PR、觸發 Actions 或把私有庫內容寫到公開處
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction (for example, hidden in an issue) could make it push code, merge PRs, trigger Actions, or write private-repo content to a public location.
servers.evidence: README tool list has merge_pull_request, push_files, delete_file, create_or_update_file, actions_run_trigger, delete_repository. 'Read-Only Mode' section: --read-only flag; --toolsets / GITHUB_TOOLSETS and --tools restrict tools. Remote https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/.

servers.name: MCP Toolbox for Databases
servers.summary_zh: 以 MCP 連接 Postgres、BigQuery 等多種資料庫
servers.summary_en: Connects to databases such as Postgres and BigQuery over MCP.
servers.risk_zh: 若啟用預建 execute_sql，注入指令可執行任意 SQL，竄改、刪除或撈出整個資料庫
servers.risk_en: If the prebuilt execute_sql is enabled, an injected instruction could run arbitrary SQL to tamper with, delete, or exfiltrate the entire database.
servers.evidence: README: prebuilt generic tools incl. `list_tables`, `execute_sql`; `--prebuilt=<db>/<toolset>` loads a subset; custom tools.yaml defines only the specific parameterized SQL tools and toolsets you allow. Self-hosted server (Google, vendor).

servers.name: Atlassian (Jira/Confluence)
servers.summary_zh: 搜尋與編輯 Jira 工單和 Confluence 頁面
servers.summary_en: Search and edit Jira issues and Confluence pages.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可大量改寫或刪除工單與文件頁面，或把內部 Confluence 內容貼到他處
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could mass-rewrite or delete issues and document pages, or paste internal Confluence content elsewhere.
servers.evidence: README 'Key Tools' + docs/tools-reference.mdx (jira_delete_issue, confluence_delete_page). docs/configuration.mdx: READ_ONLY_MODE, ENABLED_TOOLS, TOOLSETS. Not an official Atlassian product (README).

servers.name: Notion MCP Server
servers.summary_zh: 讀寫 Notion 頁面、資料庫與留言
servers.summary_en: Read and write Notion pages, databases, and comments.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可改寫或刪除頁面內容、搬移頁面，或把工作區資料寫進對外分享的頁面
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could rewrite or delete page content, move pages, or write workspace data into a publicly shared page.
servers.evidence: Tool names from repo scripts/notion-openapi.json operationIds (post-page, patch-page, delete-a-block, move-page, create-a-comment) and README (update-page-markdown). README: create a read-only integration token by granting only 'Read content'. README NOTE: this local repo is 'no longer actively maintained'; Notion recommends hosted Remote Notion MCP (https://mcp.notion.com/mcp, registry com.notion/mcp), whose source is not in this repo.

servers.name: Obsidian
servers.auth: API key (Obsidian Local REST API plugin)
servers.summary_zh: 透過 Local REST API 讀寫 Obsidian 筆記庫
servers.summary_en: Read and write an Obsidian vault via the Local REST API.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可改寫或刪除筆記與資料夾，或讀出整個筆記庫的私人內容
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could rewrite or delete notes and folders, or read out the private contents of the entire vault.
servers.evidence: src/mcp_obsidian/tools.py tool names (obsidian_append_content, obsidian_patch_content, obsidian_put_content, obsidian_delete_file); README lists delete_file 'Delete a file or directory'. No read-only option documented.

servers.name: Supabase
servers.summary_zh: 管理 Supabase 專案：資料表、SQL、Edge Functions
servers.summary_en: Manage Supabase projects: tables, SQL, and Edge Functions.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可執行 SQL、套用遷移、部署函式，或建立會產生費用的新專案
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could run SQL, apply migrations, deploy functions, or create new projects that incur charges.
servers.evidence: Tool names from packages/mcp-server-supabase/src/tools/*.ts (execute_sql, apply_migration, deploy_edge_function, delete_branch, create_project, pause_project). README: `read_only=true`, `project_ref` scoping and `features=` in server URL; create_project uses get_cost/confirm_cost cost confirmation (src/tools/confirmation.ts).

servers.name: WhatsApp (lharries)
servers.auth: QR-code login to personal WhatsApp (local bridge)
servers.summary_zh: 以你的個人 WhatsApp 帳號搜尋、讀取並傳送訊息
servers.summary_en: Search, read, and send messages from your personal WhatsApp account.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可用你的名義傳訊或傳檔給任何人，把私人對話內容轉寄出去（README 自己警告致命三要素）
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could send messages or files to anyone in your name and forward private conversations out (the README itself warns of the lethal trifecta).
servers.evidence: README tool list: send_message, send_file, send_audio_message, download_media; README Caution cites the 'lethal trifecta'. Last push 2025-07-13 (>12 months) but kept as the canonical, most-starred WhatsApp MCP. No read-only option.

servers.name: Google Workspace MCP
servers.summary_zh: 操作 Gmail、日曆、雲端硬碟、文件與試算表
servers.summary_en: Operate Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, and Sheets.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可代你寄信、建立轉寄篩選器、把雲端檔案分享給外人或改刪行程
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could send mail on your behalf, create forwarding filters, share Drive files with outsiders, or change and delete calendar events.
servers.evidence: Function names from gmail/gmail_tools.py, gdrive/drive_tools.py, gcalendar/calendar_tools.py. README: --read-only, --tool-tier core/extended/complete, --tools <service>, per-service --permissions. Self-hostable for orgs (streamable HTTP).

servers.name: Slack (korotovsky)
servers.auth: Slack user/bot token or browser session token (xoxc/xoxd)
servers.summary_zh: 讀取 Slack 頻道與私訊並可發送訊息
servers.summary_en: Read Slack channels and DMs, with the option to send messages.
servers.risk_zh: 開啟發訊後，注入指令可用你的身分在頻道發文或外洩對話；可用瀏覽器 session token 繞過一般權限
servers.risk_en: Once sending is enabled, an injected instruction could post in channels as you or leak conversations; a browser session token can bypass normal permissions.
servers.evidence: README tool headings 1-18; conversations_add_message disabled by default, enabled via SLACK_MCP_ADD_MESSAGE_TOOL (true or channel-ID allowlist); reactions and mark tools also opt-in; SLACK_MCP_ENABLED_TOOLS exists. Not an official Slack server.

servers.name: Telegram (chigwell)
servers.summary_zh: 以你的 Telegram 帳號讀寫聊天、群組與聯絡人
servers.summary_en: Read and write chats, groups, and contacts from your Telegram account.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可代你發訊、轉寄、刪除聊天記錄或按下機器人按鈕（可能觸發付款）
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could send messages, forward, or delete chat history on your behalf, or press bot inline buttons (which may trigger payments).
servers.evidence: telegram_mcp/tools/messages.py function names; README: TELEGRAM_EXPOSED_TOOLS=read-only (or read-only+<tool>) and a chat-access allowlist that hides other chats; file tools restricted by extension allowlist.

servers.name: Microsoft 365 (Softeria)
servers.summary_zh: 操作 Outlook 郵件、日曆、OneDrive、Teams
servers.summary_en: Operate Outlook mail, calendar, OneDrive, and Teams.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可代你寄信或在 Teams 發言、分享 OneDrive 檔案給外人、刪除郵件與檔案
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could send mail or post in Teams on your behalf, share OneDrive files with outsiders, or delete mail and files.
servers.evidence: Tool names from src/endpoints.json (334 toolName entries). README: --read-only, --enabled-tools regex, --preset, --org-mode gate org tools.

servers.name: Resend
servers.summary_zh: 透過 Resend 寄送郵件、管理聯絡人與電子報
servers.summary_en: Send email and manage contacts and newsletters through Resend.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可對外大量寄信或群發電子報（可被用來釣魚），或新增 API key、刪除寄件網域
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could send bulk mail or broadcast newsletters externally (usable for phishing), or add an API key and delete a sending domain.
servers.evidence: Tool names from src/tools/emails.ts, broadcasts.ts, apiKeys.ts, domains.ts. README: remote https://mcp.resend.com/mcp (OAuth) or local with --key/--sender/--reply-to; no read-only or tool allowlist documented.

servers.name: Discord (SaseQ)
servers.summary_zh: 以機器人身分管理 Discord 伺服器與訊息
servers.summary_en: Manage Discord servers and messages as a bot.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可發訊或私訊、刪訊息、封鎖成員、刪頻道，或建立 webhook 留下外部入口
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could send messages or DMs, delete messages, ban members, delete channels, or create a webhook that leaves an external entry point.
servers.evidence: README tool list (send_message, send_private_message, delete_message, ban_member, delete_channel, create_webhook among ~90). Runs via Docker (stdio or http://localhost:8085/mcp). No read-only option documented.

servers.name: LetsFG (flights & hotels)
servers.summary_zh: 搜尋並實際預訂機票與飯店，以綁定卡片付款
servers.summary_en: Search for and actually book flights and hotels, paying with a card on file.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可用你綁定的卡片訂下真實機票或飯店，或取消既有訂房
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could book real flights or hotels on your card on file, or cancel an existing reservation.
servers.evidence: README: book_flight ('fare held on your card, agent buys the ticket, real PNR'), book_hotel / book_hotel_and_wait, cancel_hotel_booking; price guard: booking refused as price_mismatch unless expected_price etc. copied verbatim; idempotency_key prevents double booking. Remote https://letsfg.co/developers/api/mcp or npx letsfg-mcp. No read-only mode. Repo created 2026-03; GitHub reports NOASSERTION, LICENSE file is MIT.

servers.name: Stripe
servers.summary_zh: 查詢與操作 Stripe 帳務：付款、退款、訂閱、發票
servers.summary_en: Query and operate Stripe billing: payments, refunds, subscriptions, and invoices.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可透過通用寫入工具建立退款、付款連結或取消訂閱；部分高風險動作需人工核准
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could use the generic write tool to create refunds or payment links or cancel subscriptions; some high-risk actions require human approval.
servers.evidence: docs.stripe.com/mcp Tools table: stripe_api_search/details/read, stripe_api_write (any POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE). Docs: Stripe requires human confirmation (approval URL) for certain stripe_api_write actions such as refunds and outbound payments; permissions limited by restricted/agent keys (tools/modelcontextprotocol/README: 'Tool permissions are controlled by your Restricted API Key'). Remote https://mcp.stripe.com; local npx @stripe/mcp. Repo stars are for the whole stripe/ai repo (formerly agent-toolkit).

servers.name: Coinbase AgentKit (MCP extension)
servers.summary_zh: 給代理一個鏈上加密錢包，可轉帳、兌換與 DeFi 操作
servers.summary_en: Gives the agent an on-chain crypto wallet for transfers, swaps, and DeFi operations.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可把錢包資產轉給攻擊者、授權代幣額度或執行兌換，鏈上交易無法撤回
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could transfer wallet assets to an attacker, approve token allowances, or execute swaps, and on-chain transactions cannot be reversed.
servers.evidence: MCP extension getMcpTools() exposes AgentKit actions; names are `<ClassName>_<action>` (actionDecorator.ts) from wallet/walletActionProvider.ts (native_transfer), erc20 (transfer, approve), cdp/cdpEvmWalletActionProvider.ts (swap, use_spend_permission). Action providers are chosen in code; no read-only mode documented. Providers also include twitter/farcaster. Stars are for the whole agentkit repo; LICENSE.md is Apache-2.0.

servers.name: Alpaca
servers.summary_zh: 下單買賣美股、ETF、選擇權與加密貨幣
servers.summary_en: Place orders to buy and sell US stocks, ETFs, options, and crypto.
servers.risk_zh: 切到實盤後，注入指令可直接下單、全部平倉或行使選擇權，造成實際虧損
servers.risk_en: Once switched to live trading, an injected instruction could place orders, close all positions, or exercise options outright, causing real losses.
servers.evidence: README tool list (place_*_order, close_all_positions, cancel_all_orders, exercise_options_position). ALPACA_PAPER_TRADE defaults to true (paper); ALPACA_TOOLSETS restricts toolsets (e.g. stock-data,crypto-data only). README warns not to expose HTTP mode publicly.

servers.name: MetaTrader 5
servers.summary_zh: 透過 MT5 終端下單外匯、差價合約並管理部位
servers.summary_en: Place forex and CFD orders and manage positions through the MT5 terminal.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可在真實帳戶開倉、改停損或全部平倉；SSE 模式本身無驗證
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could open positions, change stop-losses, or close all positions on a live account; the SSE mode itself has no authentication.
servers.evidence: README tool list (place_market_order, place_pending_order, close_all_positions, modify_position, cancel_all_pending_orders). README risk disclaimer and 'Security Warning: The MCP protocol does not include authentication' for SSE. Demo or live accounts; no read-only mode documented.

servers.name: OKX Agent Trade Kit
servers.summary_zh: OKX 交易所現貨、合約、理財與交易機器人操作
servers.summary_en: OKX exchange spot, swap, earn, and trading-bot operations.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可下單、加槓桿、平倉或申購理財商品，在實盤帳戶造成損失
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could place orders, add leverage, close positions, or buy earn products, causing losses on a live account.
servers.evidence: docs/modules/spot.md, swap.md, earn.md tool names. README 'Safety controls': --read-only flag, per-module filtering, rate limiter. docs/configuration.md: demo profile (demo = true) vs live keys.

servers.name: Razorpay
servers.summary_zh: Razorpay 收款、付款連結、訂單與退款管理
servers.summary_en: Razorpay collection, payment links, orders, and refund management.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可發起付款、送出 OTP 完成扣款、建立付款連結或退款
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could initiate payments, submit an OTP to complete a charge, create payment links, or issue refunds.
servers.evidence: README tools table (capture_payment, initiate_payment, resend_otp/submit_otp, create_payment_link, create_refund, create_order). Config: TOOLSETS / --toolsets and READ_ONLY / --read-only. Remote https://mcp.razorpay.com/mcp.

servers.name: Square
servers.summary_zh: 以通用 API 呼叫操作 Square 付款、訂單、退款與庫存
servers.summary_en: Operate Square payments, orders, refunds, and inventory via a generic API call.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可透過通用 API 工具建立付款、退款或修改訂單；遠端預設連正式環境
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could use the generic API tool to create payments or refunds or modify orders; the remote mode defaults to the production environment.
servers.evidence: README: three tools get_service_info, get_type_info, make_api_request covering services incl. payments, refunds, payouts, orders. DISALLOW_WRITES=true restricts to read-only; SANDBOX=true for sandbox. Remote https://mcp.squareup.com/sse (OAuth). README labels it Beta; last push 2026-04-09.

servers.name: PayPal
servers.summary_zh: PayPal 訂單、付款、退款、發票與訂閱管理
servers.summary_en: PayPal order, payment, refund, invoice, and subscription management.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可建立並支付訂單、退款、寄出發票或接受爭議賠付
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could create and pay orders, issue refunds, send invoices, or accept dispute claims.
servers.evidence: README tool list (create_order, pay_order, create_refund, send_invoice, cancel_subscription, accept_dispute_claim). `--tools=` selects which tools load; PAYPAL_ENVIRONMENT SANDBOX/PRODUCTION. Registry also lists remote com.paypal.mcp/mcp (https://mcp.paypal.com/mcp). Small repo (low stars, last push 2025-10-28); PayPal also ships paypal/agent-toolkit.

servers.name: Browser Use (MCP server)
servers.auth: none (LLM API key for agent tool)
servers.summary_zh: 讓代理以 Browser Use 操控瀏覽器、自動完成網頁任務
servers.summary_en: Lets the agent drive the browser with Browser Use to complete web tasks automatically.
servers.risk_zh: 注入的網頁內容可讓它在已登入的網站上點擊、輸入並交給自主代理完成多步驟操作
servers.risk_en: Injected web content could make it click and type on logged-in sites and hand multi-step operations off to an autonomous agent.
servers.evidence: browser_use/mcp/server.py tool names (browser_navigate, browser_click, browser_type, retry_with_browser_use_agent; read tools annotated read_only_hint). Optional allowed_domains restricts navigation for the agent session; no read-only mode. Stars (117k) are for the whole browser-use agent library, not just its MCP server.

servers.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
servers.summary_zh: 以 Chrome DevTools 操控、除錯與分析即時瀏覽器
servers.summary_en: Drive, debug, and profile a live browser through Chrome DevTools.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可在已登入的分頁執行 JavaScript、填表上傳檔案或安裝擴充功能
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could run JavaScript in a logged-in tab, fill forms and upload files, or install extensions.
servers.evidence: docs/tool-reference.md (evaluate_script, fill_form, click, upload_file, navigate_page, install_extension). docs/configuration.md: --category-input / --category-navigation / --category-extensions etc. toggle tool groups; --isolated, --allowed-url-pattern. README disclaimer: clients can inspect and modify any data in the browser.

servers.name: Playwright MCP
servers.summary_zh: 以 Playwright 操控瀏覽器：導覽、點擊、填表、截圖
servers.summary_en: Drive the browser with Playwright: navigate, click, fill forms, and screenshot.
servers.risk_zh: 注入的網頁內容可讓它執行任意程式碼、上傳本機檔案或在已登入網站代你操作
servers.risk_en: Injected web content could make it run arbitrary code, upload local files, or act on your behalf on logged-in sites.
servers.evidence: README tool list (browser_run_code_unsafe, browser_evaluate, browser_file_upload, browser_fill_form, browser_set_storage_state). README 'Security': 'Playwright MCP is not a security boundary'; --allowed-origins explicitly 'does not serve as a security boundary'. No read-only mode; --caps only adds capabilities.

servers.name: Chrome MCP Server (extension)
servers.summary_zh: 透過擴充功能操控你日常使用的 Chrome（含登入狀態）
servers.summary_en: Drives your everyday Chrome, including its logged-in state, through an extension.
servers.risk_zh: 直接用你的真實瀏覽器與登入狀態：注入指令可注入腳本、送出請求、讀取瀏覽紀錄與書籤
servers.risk_en: It uses your real browser and logged-in state directly: an injected instruction could inject scripts, send requests, and read your browsing history and bookmarks.
servers.evidence: README tool list (chrome_inject_script, chrome_click_element, chrome_fill_or_select, chrome_network_request, chrome_history, chrome_bookmark_delete). Extension-based, streamable HTTP to local bridge. No read-only option documented. Last push 2026-01-06.

servers.name: Desktop Commander
servers.summary_zh: 在本機執行終端指令、管理程序並讀寫檔案
servers.summary_en: Run terminal commands, manage processes, and read and write files on the local machine.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可執行任意 shell 指令、改寫檔案，甚至用 set_config_value 放寬自身限制
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could run arbitrary shell commands, rewrite files, and even use set_config_value to loosen its own restrictions.
servers.evidence: README tool list (start_process, interact_with_process, write_file, edit_block, kill_process, set_config_value). README: guardrails are 'not a sandbox' (command blocklist, allowedDirectories, symlink checks); Docker install for isolation. Remote control via mcp.desktopcommander.app. No read-only mode.

servers.name: Mobile MCP
servers.summary_zh: 操控 iOS／Android 手機與模擬器的 App
servers.summary_en: Drive apps on iOS/Android phones and emulators.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可在已登入的手機 App 上點擊輸入、安裝或移除 App，代你完成任何畫面操作
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could tap and type in logged-in mobile apps, install or uninstall apps, and perform any on-screen operation on your behalf.
servers.evidence: README tool list (mobile_install_app, mobile_uninstall_app, mobile_type_keys, mobile_click_on_screen_at_coordinates, mobile_open_url). MOBILEMCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_URLS: non-standard URL schemes blocked by default. No read-only/tool allowlist documented. Telemetry on by default.

servers.name: Windows-MCP
servers.auth: local machine access (OAuth for remote access)
servers.summary_zh: 操控 Windows 桌面：點擊、輸入、PowerShell、登錄檔
servers.summary_en: Drive the Windows desktop: clicks, typing, PowerShell, and the registry.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可執行 PowerShell、修改登錄檔、刪檔或結束程序，等同取得整台電腦
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could run PowerShell, modify the registry, delete files, or kill processes, amounting to control of the whole machine.
servers.evidence: README 'MCP Tools' list (PowerShell, FileSystem read/write/delete, Registry read/write/delete, Process terminate, App launch). `windows-mcp serve --tools ...` whitelist and `--exclude-tools "PowerShell,Registry"`.

servers.name: Playwright (ExecuteAutomation)
servers.summary_zh: 社群版 Playwright 瀏覽器自動化與 API 測試
servers.summary_en: Community Playwright browser automation and API testing.
servers.risk_zh: 注入指令可在頁面執行 JavaScript、上傳本機檔案，或直接發出任意 HTTP 寫入請求
servers.risk_en: An injected instruction could run JavaScript on the page, upload local files, or directly issue arbitrary HTTP write requests.
servers.evidence: src/tools.ts tool names (playwright_evaluate, playwright_upload_file, playwright_fill, playwright_post/put/patch/delete). No read-only option documented. Last push 2025-12-13.
